_about: Input common-mode range and input bias current against input common-mode voltage for the 25 op amps of the high-gain note (Section 8.6, Table A.9, Figure A.1). Table values were read from rendered specification tables; curve values were read by eye from renders at 300-1000 dpi of the typical-performance plots, with the sign as printed. Every cell names the one datasheet table, section or figure it comes from, with its 1-based PDF page; § marks a numbered section of a datasheet (TI numbers its specification tables as sections), and doc is the reference of Appendix D. 'map' holds the plotted limits in volts above the negative rail, at the total supply vs of the part's curve, for Figure A.1: g = guaranteed input range, t = typical range where it is wider, w = span in which the plotted bias current stays within twice its mid-supply value (or the band stated in the cell), spec = common-mode voltage(s) of the datasheet's bias-current specification. 'src' gives the table and the figure that the row of Figure A.1 is drawn from. null means not given.
